The discussion recommends daily albendazole 10 mg/kg for 12 months after surgery and then says "This regimen was prescribed to the patients"; the case narrative only says he was discharged with instructions to take albendazole.

The abstract says intravenous fluids were given as immediate treatment; the case narrative names normal saline (during transport and 3 liters overall) and hydration without a route. The source does not equate them.
